features.cite: Zertal 2005 (Eng. Vol. 4) Site 45, p. 200 (quoting Conder and Kitchener 1882: 246)
features.quote: An artificial mound, now occupied by an Arab graveyard.

date.basis: entry (British Survey quote) describes an Arab graveyard in use on the mound, i.e. a Muslim-period burial ground

notes: Site not visited by the Zertal team (minefield); observed from c. 200 m. The graveyard is on the tell itself, so no direction (position none); grave type not stated, coded as not a cavity. Data block says 'Cisterns: not known', which is not an absence statement. No plan (Fig. 99 is a photograph).
